ValidationRule.description: This VD Checks for any changes in the Transfer Object after it is created.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( OR( ISCHANGED( New_Commitment__c ) , ISCHANGED( Commitment_Name__c ) , ISCHANGED( Transfer_Amount_nearest__c ), ISCHANGED(Transfer_to_Limited_Partner__c) , ISCHANGED( Transfer_to_Partnership__c )) ,true,false)
